from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference/play/users/u050/system/state/workspace/programs/task-a04f8797.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    line_colors = set()
    for row in grid:
        if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != background:
            line_colors.add(row[0])
    for c in range(w):
        vals = {grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}
        if len(vals) == 1:
            v = next(iter(vals))
            if v != background:
                line_colors.add(v)
    line_cells = set()
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] in line_colors:
            line_cells.update((r, c) for c in range(w))
    for c in range(w):
        vals = {grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}
        if len(vals) == 1 and next(iter(vals)) in line_colors:
            line_cells.update((r, c) for r in range(h))
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r, c in line_cells:
        out[r][c] = 2
    return out
'''
